_note: DOC-DERIVED, NOT CAPTURES (ADR-013). Probe P7 could not exhaust the account's credits, and no probe produced a failed response. creditsExhausted429/403 bodies are the sentence quoted in public bug reports of the live API (continuedev/continue#10373 reports HTTP 429, LCV-Ideas-Software/cross-review#270 reports HTTP 403), team id replaced by a placeholder; xAI's error reference (docs.x.ai/docs/key-information/debugging, read 2026-10-03) documents 403 and 429 with no body. The failed/cancelled responses follow the Responses API response object. xAI's API reference (docs.x.ai/docs/api-reference, read 2026-10-03) lists status completed|in_progress|incomplete and names an `error` object without its shape or codes; the failed and cancelled statuses and the error codes (server_error, rate_limit_exceeded, invalid_prompt, bio_policy, misalignment_policy_violation, image_*, ...) come from OpenAI's Responses object as typed in the openai SDK 7.22.0 (`ResponseError.code`), which xAI's API is compatible with. `error` is documented there as set only when the response failed, and live xAI captures carry `error: null`; a completed response with an error object is not a documented shape and has no fixture. Every `message` below is a placeholder, not provider text. Replace each with a pinned capture when one exists.
